summary: Frame::try_new gate corrected TO SPEC (spec section 8.1): z_hat is the expansion POINT in R^n and carries no unit constraint; the unit requirements live on the frame basis (q_tau unit, Q orthonormal). Removed the shim-time unit-z_hat refusal from vendor/truck/truck-certified/src/kernel/certs.rs Frame::try_new; only finiteness is now required of z_hat (enforced by the existing all_finite_frame gate), while q_tau-unit (TOL_JACOBIAN), q-orthonormality (TOL_JACOBIAN), q_perp-as-complement-of-q_tau, and finite-a checks are kept verbatim. The Frame doc comment and the z_hat field doc now cite section 8.1 (expansion point; the basis carries the unit constraints). The shim contract test frame_refuses_non_orthonormal_basis keeps its landed name and its orthonormality/q_tau assertions; its former non-unit-normal refusal assertion was replaced IN PLACE by a non-unit-z_hat acceptance case plus a non-finite-z_hat finiteness refusal. The new required test frame_try_new_accepts_nonunit_z_hat_and_still_gates_the_basis covers both directions: accepts the [0.3, 0.7, 1.2, 0.5]-class non-unit point with a valid basis (and asserts the probe is genuinely non-unit), refuses a non-unit q_tau, and refuses non-finite z_hat (NaN and infinity). This unblocks mid-branch frame rebuilds (S4A fixture 3 frame_zhat_not_unit; build_frame4 constructs frames at arbitrary box centers and gates z_hat on finiteness only). RESULT.json is at the worktree root.
